title: connect_ws scheme check uses lowercased copy but passes original URL
description: connect_ws lowercases ws_url for the scheme guard check but passes the original ws_url to into_client_request(). A URL like 'WS://host/path' passes the guard but into_client_request may or may not handle uppercase schemes depending on the tungstenite version. If tungstenite rejects it, the caller gets ClientError::WebSocket instead of InvalidArgument. The guard should either normalize the URL before passing to tungstenite, or accept only strictly lowercase schemes so the mismatch cannot occur.
